claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol, and deliver actionable insights.
claims.quote: Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [2], and deliver actionable insights.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The platform includes a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for turning conversational insights into reusable dashboard components.
claims.quote: The platform features a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for transforming conversational insights into reusable dashboard components.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Evaluation on 300 end-to-end test cases over synthetic and production enterprise datasets reports 95.3% functional accuracy, 24-second mean response latency, 4.52/5.0 response quality, 93.0% hallucination-free rate, 22.6 percentage point accuracy improvement, and 20.2% quality gain over a single-agent baseline.
claims.quote: Evaluation across 300 end-to-end test cases spanning synthetic and production enterprise datasets demonstrates 95.3% functional accuracy, a mean response latency of 24 seconds, and a response quality score of 4.52/5.0 as assessed by an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, with a 93.0% hallucination-free rate, representing a 22.6 percentage point accuracy improvement and 20.2% quality gain over a single-agent baseline.

claims.question: q3

claims.quote: Cross-model evaluation across four LLM backends and human expert validation confirm architectural generalizability and evaluator reliability.
